perSample.what: the real Tendril.app host <-> daemon traffic, through a proxy via a shadow TENDRIL_HOME, from the launch until the first burst settled (1.5 s quiet); compare with the IPC shim cold-load net leg
perSample.includesBridgeSetup: the host connects its WebSocket and SSE bridges at launch, inside this window; the shim connects them at its own start, outside its cold-load window

notes: Bytes are counted on the wire by a TCP proxy (lib/tcpproxy.ts) that follows HTTP/1.1 and WebSocket framing: application-layer bytes in each direction (HTTP heads and bodies, WebSocket frame headers and payloads, SSE streams), TCP/IP headers excluded. Assets are requests the browser marks Sec-Fetch-Dest document/script/style/font/image (or GET of a static file extension); data is everything else (total minus assets).

Leg "ui" (the like-for-like comparison) = what the page exchanges with its backend, assets and data counted separately: for V1 browser <-> V1 server; for V2 browser <-> shim, which in the real Tauri app is in-process IPC plus assets from the app bundle and never touches a socket. Leg "net" = architecture-internal loopback sockets: for V1 the same leg as "ui"; for V2 host <-> daemon only (the host is the IPC shim running the real tendril-app command handlers and bridges, reaching the daemon through a shadow TENDRIL_HOME whose .master points at the proxy), so it carries no assets and no IPC.

Per dataset and app: 3 cold loads (fresh context) each followed by first visits of jobs, review, dashboard, plans; 1 idle window(s) of 20 s on a warm page; 3 REST pushes (the PUT itself goes straight to the server and is not counted); 1 scripted session(s) of load + every view + 2 pushes. A window ends when no byte has moved on either leg for 1500 ms (at most 20 s), so background traffic inside it (V2's 5 s job poll, SignalR keep-alives) is included; the idle scenario measures that background alone. Headless Chromium 1280x800, as in the ui suite.

V2/empty: shim bridged through the host->daemon proxy via a shadow TENDRIL_HOME (symlinks to the daemon's home, own .master); failed IPC commands across all pages: cmd_list_all_recommendations x5 (cmd_list_all_recommendations is known V2 bug F1; cmd_get_verification_report finds no report file in the generated plans; both fail the same way in the ui suite, where the shim uses the real home).

V2/small: shim bridged through the host->daemon proxy via a shadow TENDRIL_HOME (symlinks to the daemon's home, own .master); failed IPC commands across all pages: cmd_list_all_recommendations x5, cmd_get_verification_report x4 (cmd_list_all_recommendations is known V2 bug F1; cmd_get_verification_report finds no report file in the generated plans; both fail the same way in the ui suite, where the shim uses the real home).

V2/large: shim bridged through the host->daemon proxy via a shadow TENDRIL_HOME (symlinks to the daemon's home, own .master); failed IPC commands across all pages: cmd_list_all_recommendations x5, cmd_list_recommendations x1882, cmd_get_verification_report x4 (cmd_list_all_recommendations is known V2 bug F1; cmd_get_verification_report finds no report file in the generated plans; both fail the same way in the ui suite, where the shim uses the real home).

desktop-external: each real desktop app (small dataset) watched with `nettop -s 1 -m tcp -t external` over every process, started before the app (and V2's daemon) was spawned and run for 30 s, then filtered to the app, its WebKit processes, (V2) the daemon and their descendants; loopback excluded. Both apps run their shipped background fetches (V1's model pricing warmup, V2's model enrichment). A lower bound: a socket opened and closed between two 1 s samples is missed.
real-host-cold-load: tendril-app was connected to the daemon through the proxy (shadow home; 40 request(s) in the cold-load window)
V2 "ui" leg: role of the far end is the IPC shim (stand-in for the tendril-app host; not the Tauri binary).
